gloss: to dish up; to plate (food); to arrange on a plate

forms.negative: {盛|も}り{付|つ}けませんでした

forms.negative: {盛|も}り{付|つ}けていなかった

definitions.gloss: to dish up; to plate food; to arrange food on a dish
definitions.explanation: To arrange and present food attractively on a plate or dish. Emphasizes both the act of serving and the aesthetic presentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To plate the salad on a dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to plate food beautifully.

examples.japanese: ⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ひとつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}けて、⟦{彩|いろど}り→彩り：12506_irodori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}っていた→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: The chef carefully plated each dish, paying attention to the color arrangement as well.

notes:
{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける is a transitive ichidan verb. The noun form is ⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧ (plating, presentation).

ASPECT (ている):
{盛|も}り{付|つ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the action is in progress.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate A on B)
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate food)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate beautifully)
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate carefully)
- ⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}ける (to plate on a large dish)
- ⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧ (way of plating)

In Japanese cuisine, presentation is highly valued. The related noun ⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧ is used broadly for the art of food presentation.
